title: Careful Wording in Diplomacy
grammar: Recap: diplomatic conditionals, and two new frames
goal: I can word a careful diplomatic statement (*Úgy vélhetnénk, hogy …*, *Hajlunk arra a megállapításra, hogy …*, *aligha volna elfogadható*).
I can talk about diplomacy and the final declaration of talks (*reálpolitika*, *zárónyilatkozat*, *geopolitikai mozgástér*).
I can say, without being blunt, that a proposal is hardly acceptable.

sections.title: Unit 17: Regional Geopolitics
body: This unit is about regional geopolitics: diplomacy, borders, alliances and the history of Central Europe. You will use careful diplomatic wording, pairs such as *amerre … arra* for places and directions, chains of nouns in treaty language, *mielőtt még … volna* and *miként … akként …*.
The unit ends with a short text about Jenő Szűcs's essay on the three historical regions of Europe.
